evaluated_on: primary comparison only (M2 vs M0, L2 logistic at the fixed lambda = 10); exploratory configurations never

conditions_for_support.S2: Delta > 0 in at least 5 of the 8 development folds (a strict majority)
conditions_for_support.S3: two-way cluster (pigeonhole) bootstrap 95% percentile CI for the development pooled-OOF Delta (lambda = 10) has lower bound > 0
conditions_for_support.S4: LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION Delta PR-AUC > 0 (directional confirmation; its CI is reported, not required)

S5.name: no severe calibration deterioration on the LCUV block (primary class, fixed lambda)
S5.computed_on: LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION predictions of M0 and M2 (the same rows)

definitions.calibration_slope: coefficient b1 of an unpenalised logistic regression y ~ b0 + b1 * logit(p), with p clipped to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6], fitted by the frozen numpy/scipy routine (L-BFGS-B, gtol 1e-8, maxiter 5000)

S5.severe_deterioration: S5 fails (severe deterioration) if either inequality is violated
S5.not_computable: if a calibration slope does not converge or Brier(M0) == 0, S5 is NOT passed (an unmeasured criterion is not a satisfied one)
S5.unchanged_from_v1: the two numeric bars (1.05 and 0.20) are v1's; A02 only makes the rule machine-readable and fixes the computation and the not-computable case

conditions_for_support.S6: every check of H20_2_PIT_AUDIT_PLAN.md passes (0 violations)
conditions_for_support.S7: not driven by one era: Delta > 0 in at least 2 of the 3 era blocks {2022 folds, 2023 folds, 2025 LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION} AND the development pooled-OOF Delta stays > 0 when each fold is left out in turn

rules_in_order: DATA / DESIGN FAILURE if: S6 fails; or the sealed target checks fail (unparsable announcement time, an event matching > 1 era); or any development fold has < 5 unique positive events or the LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION block has < 20; or > 20% of landmark weeks lack every context source; or a model fails to converge twice; or the LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION block has to be opened more than once
INCREMENTAL CONTEXT SIGNAL SUPPORTED if S1-S7 all hold
NEGATIVE INCREMENTAL RESULT if the development bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 AND LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION Delta < 0
PRE-REGISTERED NULL otherwise (including any CI straddling zero, any fold-majority failure, any LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION veto)

annotations_not_verdicts.materiality: MATERIAL if absolute Delta >= 0.01 AND relative Delta >= 10% on both development and LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION, else SMALL (never converts one verdict into another)
annotations_not_verdicts.classifier_free_robustness: M2_core vs M0 evaluated identically; if the primary verdict is SUPPORTED and M2_core fails S1 or S4, annotate 'support depends on agent-audited classifiers'
annotations_not_verdicts.model_class_robustness: LightGBM M2 vs M0 evaluated identically; disagreement with the primary is annotated, never substituted
annotations_not_verdicts.context_only: M1 / M1_core reported for completeness; a context-only model ranks weeks, not assets
annotations_not_verdicts.exploratory_tuning: selected-lambda and selected-tree results are reported as exploratory; they never determine, upgrade or downgrade the verdict

never: no new verdict label after execution
no switch of primary metric, model class, arm or split
no claim of trading profitability (H20.4 territory)

inference.primary: pigeonhole two-way cluster bootstrap (Owen 2007): each replicate resamples asset-eras with replacement and, independently, calendar blocks with replacement; a row's weight = (multiplicity of its asset-era) x (multiplicity of its block); weighted PR-AUC of M2 and M0 recomputed on the same weights; Delta per replicate

blocks.development: the 8 fold test windows (13 weeks each)

inference.models_not_refit: replicates reweight fixed out-of-fold predictions; models are not refit inside the bootstrap
inference.predictions: primary class at lambda = 10 (no selection inside or outside the bootstrap)

claim_scope.if_supported: incremental context signal supported in the locked retrospective / context-unseen evaluation
claim_scope.always_append: prospective confirmation pending (PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION block, not scorable before its 365-day outcomes mature after 2027-09-28)
claim_scope.why: no H20 or context model has seen the 2025 block and the H20.2 rules are frozen before H20 scoring, but the research programme previously observed market-model behaviour in that calendar period (H18.3 holdout)

terminology_map.holdout (any v1 use, incl. 'pre-holdout: LOCKED_CONTEXT_UNSEEN_VALIDATION ('pre-LCUV freeze', 'LCUV scored once', '2025 LCUV block')
